name: ModelRegistry
observations: Central model registry at src/lib/model-registry.ts — zero project imports, leaf-level module
Three models: seedream-4-5 (default, censored, optimize_prompt_options), seedream-4-0 (uncensored, quality param), seedance-1-5-pro (video)
Types ModelId/ImageModelId/WireModelId are manually defined (not Extract-derived) because ModelRegistryEntry interface prevents const narrowing
Helper functions: getModelById, getModelByWireId, buildQualityParam, extractQualityFromRequest, getAvailableTiers, getDimensionsForTier
constants/parameters.ts now thin wrapper — getModelConstraints/getModelDefaults delegate to registry
SizeConstraints.tierDimensions maps tier names (1K/2K/4K) to SizeDimensionEntry arrays with both dimensions (API) and displayDimensions (UI with × character)

name: ResolutionTiers
observations: Seedream 4.0: 1K/2K/4K tiers, Seedream 4.5: 2K/4K only (no 1K)
size-selector.tsx has tier pill buttons above category selector
When switching models, tier auto-snaps if current tier unavailable (e.g., 1K→2K when going 4.0→4.5)
When switching tiers, same aspect ratio is preserved if available in new tier
page.tsx SIZE_OPTIONS now computed via useMemo from all tiers for current model

name: BugsFixed_20260228
observations: generation-output.tsx: Removed unconditional requestBody.quality=quality line that added spurious quality field to Seedream 4.5 cURL export (already set correctly by buildQualityParam)
use-generation.ts: Fixed inverted censorship error message — was suggesting 4.5 for less restrictive when 4.0 is uncensored. Now uses isCensored registry flag
image-upload-zone.tsx: Format tags and accept attribute now derive from model constraints instead of hardcoding all formats for all models

name: post-registry-fixes
observations: Tier dimensions refactored: ASPECT_RATIO_SEEDS seed table + buildTierDimensions() builder replaces 40 hand-written dim() calls. Add new ratio = 1 row, new model = 1 buildTierDimensions() call.
SizePreset type removed from types/api.ts (was dead: string aliased to string)
page.tsx uses `const imageModel = selectedModel as SeedreamModel` for type-safe narrowing in image-only components (guarded by !isVideo at runtime)
image-upload-zone.tsx validateImageFile deps include [model], processFiles deps use effectiveMaxImages instead of maxImages
generation-output.tsx curlCommand useMemo deps include model

name: ModelSwitchRevalidation
observations: Exported validateImageFileForModel() from image-upload-zone.tsx — standalone function usable outside the component
page.tsx model-switch effect re-validates all existing referenceImages against new model's constraints (e.g., .webp valid on 4.5 shows error on 4.0)
image-upload-zone.tsx cleanup effect uses imagesRef to avoid stale closure on unmount

name: TypeSafetyCleanup_20260301
observations: All `as any` casts removed from src/ (was 8 total across 6 files)
Supabase generated types (src/lib/supabase/types.ts) updated: presets table now includes batch_mode/max_images, removed stale seed field
use-video-history.ts: 4 DB→UI casts now use VideoDuration/VideoResolution/VideoRatio/VideoServiceTier instead of any
generation-output.tsx: requestBody typed as Record<string,unknown>, quality cast uses Quality type
page.tsx video image role typed as VideoImageRole instead of any
use-presets.ts: fetchPresets wrapped in useCallback, added to useEffect deps
page.tsx: eslint-disable-next-line on model-switch and mode-switch effects with intent comments
